escenas.texto: This week in Oceania, millions of people watched, commented and shared non-stop. The thirty videos in this countdown add up to over one hundred and seventy-three million views. But only one took number one. Welcome to Top 10 Social Media, Oceania edition. Today: the ten most viewed, the ten most commented and the ten most liked videos of the week. Stay until the end, because you won't guess number one.

The rules, quick and clear. Only videos posted in the last seven days that trended in Oceania. One video per creator on each list. Music and news have their own space. Every number comes from the official YouTube API, with the weekly cut every Wednesday at midnight, Lima, Peru time. Let's go.

Let's start with the ten most viewed videos. At number ten, from Australia, Phoenix SC, with “Hmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmm...”. Over one point two million views. It got there in just two days. It also has over one thousand comments.
Number nine, from New Zealand, Dolan Darkest, with “This Is Heartbreaking”. Over one point five million views. It got there in just one day. It also has over one thousand comments.

Coming in at number eight, MORØ, with “Indie cross ep3 sneak peek”. Over one point five million views. It has the best engagement rate on this list: seven out of every hundred viewers liked or commented. A Short of just fifty-six seconds.
At number seven, from Australia, optimum, with “We have 1000Hz monitors now.”. Over two million views. It also has over one thousand comments.

Coming in at number six, from Australia, TGG, with “GTA 6: Everything You NEED To Know 2 Days Left”. Over three point four million views. A video over fifty-four minutes long, and people still stayed to watch. It also has over four thousand comments.
Coming in at number five, from Australia, GLITCH, with “Glitch productions all bosses no damage”. Over four point five million views. It also has over eleven thousand comments.
In position number four, from Australia, BondiRescue, with “She's deep in shark territory”. Over nine point nine million views. It also has over eight thousand comments.
Bronze medal, from Australia, NickandCarrie, with “Rate our DANCE?”. Over ten million views. A Short of just sixteen seconds. It also has over one thousand comments.

Silver medal, from Australia, Double Trouble Squad, with “We are so close to 5m can you guys help us hit it?”. Over twelve million views. A Short of just thirteen seconds. It also has two hundred and eighty-nine comments.

And here it is. Number one most viewed, from Australia, Odd Tilt, with “How you invented blinds!”. Over eighteen million views. It was the fastest-growing video on this list: about one hundred and ninety thousand views per hour. A Short of just thirty-four seconds.

Now for the conversation: the ten most commented videos. Coming in at number ten, from New Zealand, Dolan Darkest, with “This Is Heartbreaking”. Over one thousand comments. It got there in just one day. It also has over one point five million views.
In position number nine, from Australia, Ken, with “おはようございます”. Over one thousand comments. It got there in just one day. It also has over five hundred and eighty-two thousand views.
Number eight, from Australia, optimum, with “We have 1000Hz monitors now.”. Over one thousand comments. It also has over two million views.
Next up, number seven, from Australia, Phoenix SC, with “Hmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmm...”. Over one thousand comments. It got there in just two days. It also has over one point two million views.

Number six, from Australia, Skill Up, with a video posted four days ago. Over two thousand comments. A video over forty-one minutes long, and people still stayed to watch. It also has over four hundred and three thousand views.

At number five, from Australia, TGG, with “GTA 6: Everything You NEED To Know 2 Days Left”. Over four thousand comments. A video over fifty-four minutes long, and people still stayed to watch. It also has over three point four million views.
In position number four, from Australia, BondiRescue, with “She's deep in shark territory”. Over eight thousand comments. It also has over nine point nine million views.

Bronze medal, MORØ, with “Indie cross ep3 sneak peek”. Over eight thousand comments. It has the best engagement rate on this list: seven out of every hundred viewers liked or commented. A Short of just fifty-six seconds.

Silver medal, from Australia, Odd Tilt, with “How you invented blinds!”. Over nine thousand comments. It was the fastest-growing video on this list: about one hundred and ninety thousand views per hour. A Short of just thirty-four seconds.
And finally, number one most commented, from Australia, GLITCH, with “Glitch productions all bosses no damage”. Over eleven thousand comments. It also has over four point five million views.

And the last list: the ten most liked videos. Next up, number ten, from Australia, Phoenix SC, with “Hmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmm...”. Over twenty-nine thousand likes. It got there in just two days. It also has over one point two million views.
Next up, number nine, from New Zealand, Viva La Dirt League, with “Stop Rushing to Endgame in WoW”. Over thirty-one thousand likes. It also has over eight hundred and ninety-nine thousand views.
At number eight, from New Zealand, Dolan Darkest, with “This Is Heartbreaking”. Over thirty-two thousand likes. It got there in just one day. It also has over one point five million views.

In position number seven, from Australia, TGG, with “GTA 6: Everything You NEED To Know 2 Days Left”. Over fifty-three thousand likes. A video over fifty-four minutes long, and people still stayed to watch. It also has over three point four million views.

Number six, from Australia, Double Trouble Squad, with “We are so close to 5m can you guys help us hit it?”. Over fifty-seven thousand likes. A Short of just thirteen seconds. It also has over twelve million views.

In position number five, MORØ, with “Indie cross ep3 sneak peek”. Over ninety-eight thousand likes. It has the best engagement rate on this list: seven out of every hundred viewers liked or commented. A Short of just fifty-six seconds.
Next up, number four, from Australia, GLITCH, with “Glitch productions all bosses no damage”. Over one hundred and seventy-five thousand likes. It also has over four point five million views.
Bronze medal, from Australia, BondiRescue, with “She's deep in shark territory”. Over one hundred and eighty-three thousand likes. It also has over nine point nine million views.
Silver medal, from Australia, NickandCarrie, with “Rate our DANCE?”. Over two hundred and twenty-seven thousand likes. A Short of just sixteen seconds. It also has over ten million views.

Drum roll, please. Number one most liked, from Australia, Odd Tilt, with “How you invented blinds!”. Over four hundred and thirty-eight thousand likes. It was the fastest-growing video on this list: about one hundred and ninety thousand views per hour. A Short of just thirty-four seconds.

And the world tour isn't over. Next stop: Asia. The link is in the description and in the playlist. Now it's your turn: which video should have made this countdown? Tell us in the comments with the hashtag Top10RS. Links to every original video are in the description: go support the creators. Subscribe and hit the bell, so you're the first to know the winners in Oceania every Sunday. And watch out: the top three of each list move on to the global ranking. Next week, that video could be yours. And a question for you: do you want us to hold a real award for the Top 10 winners? If you do, write the hashtag Premios Top 10 RS in the comments, all in one word.
